def facts():
    al = TinyDevice["KTPU"].allocator
    b = Buffer("KTPU", 20, dtypes.half).allocate()
    st = b._buf
    al._copyin(st, memoryview(np.full(20, 7, np.float16).tobytes()))
    flat = np.empty(20, np.float16)
    al._copyout(memoryview(flat).cast("B"), st)
    key = FM.rows_key(10, 32)
    rows = np.zeros((2, 32), np.float16)
    rows[:, :10] = np.arange(20).reshape(2, 10)
    DEV.write(st.form(key, rows.nbytes).addr, rows.tobytes())
    st.wrote(key)
    st.dtype = np.dtype(np.float16)
    padded = np.empty(20, np.float16)
    al._copyout(memoryview(padded).cast("B"), st)
    b.deallocate()
    return {"flat": flat.tolist(), "padded": padded.tolist()}
